answers.body: Elite Packs are packs of three reward cards that you open on your FundedElite dashboard. Cards can widen rules, remove minimum trading days, add drawdown, improve profit split, speed payouts, or give checkout discounts. You buy packs with Pack Credits (or open an eligible free pack), open them yourself, and keep every card until you apply it. Cards never change an account automatically — you apply a compatible card yourself. All FundedElite accounts are simulated trading accounts.

On the FundedElite dashboard, open Elite Packs in the main menu. The page has five tabs: Packs, My Packs, Inventory, Collection and Credits. Your two balances and the Redeem key button sit at the top right of every tab.
Every Elite Pack holds exactly three cards. Each card is drawn on its own (drop rates are per card, not whole-pack).

There is no single best pack for everyone. Higher tiers cost more credits and carry better rarity odds; Whale has an Uncommon+ floor and Oracle has a Rare+ floor. Choose based on the credits you want to spend and the rarity floor you want. Luna never guarantees you will pull a specific card.

Pack credits / floors: Ignition (Tier 1) 3,000 credits, no floor; Breakout (Tier 2) 6,000, no floor; Market Maker (Tier 3) 10,000, no floor; Whale (Tier 4) 12,500, Uncommon or better; Oracle (Tier 5) 15,000, Rare or better. Exact live offers still show on the Packs tab.

Drop rates are per card (not whole-pack probability) and may be rounded. Ignition/Breakout/Market Maker/Whale/Oracle: Common 67.3%/55.0%/42.3%/not in Whale/not in Oracle; Uncommon 27.0%/32.8%/35.4%/56.9%/not in Oracle; Rare 4.4%/9.4%/15.4%/29.6%/68.9%; Epic 1.1%/2.4%/5.4%/10.2%/24.2%; Legendary 0.14%/0.45%/1.4%/3.1%/6.4%; Mythic 0.004%/0.014%/0.055%/0.19%/0.42%; Exotic not in Ignition–Market Maker / 0.050% Whale / 0.080% Oracle; Primordial is not normally in ordinary odds (Whale/Oracle only after full collection). Never treat these as a guarantee of any card. Collection may show per-card odds on the dashboard.

There are 76 regular collection cards across six rarities (Common 9, Uncommon 13, Rare 13, Epic 14, Legendary 13, Mythic 14), plus 4 Exotic cards (80 total for full collection discovery), and 1 Primordial card (The Million) beyond that.
A floor is the lowest rarity a pack can hold. Whale never contains Common; every Oracle card is Rare or better.

Elite Packs uses two balances. Pack Credits buy Elite Packs only: they are not withdrawable, transferable, resellable, or cash, cannot buy challenges, have no monetary value, and expire with the account. Payout Credits are your approved payout balance: withdrawable as cash or usable for eligible challenge purchases, and you may voluntarily convert them to Pack Credits (only the converted part stops being withdrawable). Conversion is always an explicit customer choice.

Add credits on the Credits tab (or + next to credits): pick a bundle, choose One off or Monthly, then pay by card, crypto, or Payout Credits. Bigger bundles may show a bonus on the live dashboard. Luna never purchases or tops up credits for you. Exact bundle sizes/bonuses are live-dashboard only.

freshness.customerDirective: Exact bundle sizes and bonuses are live on the Credits tab.

answers.body: To convert Payout Credits into Pack Credits: on the Credits tab choose Payout Credits as payment (1 Payout Credit per $1 of the selected bundle), or when opening a pack short on credits the dashboard may offer Convert and buy for just the shortfall. Nothing converts unless you choose it.

Pack Credits cannot be cashed out or transferred. Payout Credits remain withdrawable until you voluntarily convert them. Unexpected charges, refund disputes, missing credits, or subscription status issues go to the human team.

Monthly plans charge today, then on the same date every month until cancelled. Credits arrive on that billing date. Monthly may offer larger quantities than the same one-off amount. Cancel from the Credits tab; cancel stops the next renewal, and the paid period stays active until it ends. Luna never subscribes or cancels for you.
Cancel a Monthly credits plan from the Credits tab (FAQ: two clicks). The plan stays active until the end of the month you have paid for, then stops. Luna does not cancel subscriptions.
Crypto payments are 5% off the bundle price on one-off bundles. Luna never processes payments.

On Packs, press Open pack. Cut the seal or press Skip · Fast open. Credits are deducted at cut seal / Fast open, not at preview. Fast open does not change odds. Closing before reveal is not charged. A free copy of a pack is always used before credits. All three cards go to Inventory.

After a credit-bought pack: 15% off the same pack within 2 minutes, then 20% from the third successive; upgrade offer 10% off the next higher pack (Oracle has no upgrade). After a free pack: 5% same pack + 10% next tier for 90 seconds. Special Pack and chain discounts do not stack — the better offer applies. Never promise an offer is still active.

answers.body: Cards wait on Inventory under Challenge, Funded/Instant, Discount, or Exotic. To apply: Use card → review effect/rarity/uses → select a compatible account → Apply card. Discount cards: Use card → Save for checkout for an eligible future purchase. Luna never applies upgrades or announces that an account changed.
No. A card only changes an account when you apply it and pick the account yourself. Discount cards only apply at checkout after you choose Save for checkout.

Cards marked ×2, ×3 or ×5 carry that many uses. Each use goes to a separate account or separate purchase, one at a time. Used-up cards leave Inventory but stay in Collection. Duplicate pulls combine uses.

Ordinary discount cards may stack with applicable checkout offers as stated on the card. Founder's Key is the exception: 60% off eligible platform purchases for 1 year and does NOT combine with other website discounts.

Card labels use exact eligible types such as Challenge, 2 Step Challenge, Funded, Instant, Any account, or Checkout. Only compatible accounts appear when you Apply. Example families include Skip a Trading Day, Drawdown Buffer, Split 70/80/90, Leverage Boost 1:50, Funded Weekend Trading, Funded Scalping, Skip a Step, payout timing cards, Payout Boost 100%, One Day Minimum, Funded Reset, Drawdown Ceiling 15%, Consistency boosts, and checkout discount cards.

Four Exotic cards (Whale/Oracle only; once per trader for life): Instant Override — three 400K Instant Elite accounts (one per use; credentials within 24h); Lifetime Split — 100% split on qualifying accounts now and future for life; Founder's Key — 60% off eligible platform purchases for 1 year, does not combine with other website discounts; Open Season — removes scalping restrictions on qualifying Challenge/Instant/funded accounts for 12 months. Luna never asserts ownership, qualification, receipt, or an Exotic upgrade for any trader.

The Million is the Primordial card: a $1,000,000 simulated account, instantly funded, 100% split, 15% max drawdown, 7% daily drawdown, 2 minimum trading days, 1:100 leverage, no scaling/weekend/consistency restrictions, non-transferable, permanent. It is not in ordinary odds; after you discover the full 80-card collection, Whale/Oracle can produce it; once per lifetime. Claim: Inventory → Claim The Million; team opens within 24h. Do not say every risk rule is removed: max and daily drawdown and minimum trading days still apply per the FAQ table. Never promise a win or that a customer has The Million.

Lucky streak: openings without Epic+ fill a meter; when full, the next pack guarantees Epic or better; pulling Epic+ resets the meter. Exact thresholds are dashboard-only — Luna will not invent a number.
Pack Pass: eligible credit-purchased packs advance the meter; when full you get a free Ignition Pack. Free packs do not count. Exact thresholds are dashboard-only.

Special Packs are time-limited deals with a countdown on the Packs tab; they expire when the timer ends. If a Special Pack and a chain discount both apply, the better offer wins. Never promise an offer is still active.

My Packs holds unopened free packs (promos, giveaways, keys, Pack Pass). Redeem key is at the top of the Elite Packs dashboard; keys are single-use. Luna never invents, exposes, validates, or redeems a key.
Collection tracks discovered cards and recent pulls, and can show odds for cards in the pack you pick. Per-card odds and your personal discovery progress are dashboard-only.

Eligible new-account purchases can include a free Elite Pack and pack credits. Published Help Center tiers and the current launch landing promo disagree on some account sizes, discounts, and credit amounts, so Luna will not quote a specific free-pack tier, discount percent, or credit amount as settled fact. Check My Packs and Credits on your dashboard for what you actually received. Elite Atom same-order multi-account bundle promos are separate from Elite Packs launch free-pack promos.

Purchases are generally final, subject to statutory withdrawal rights under the Italian Consumer Code where they apply for immediate digital content. Pack Credits are not cashable. Luna does not give legal conclusions on an individual case; refund or charge disputes go to the human team. Elite Packs are for traders aged 18+.

If a pack, card, reward, key, or credits did not show up, contact support with the pack/card name, an account identifier, and the approximate time. Never send passwords, OTPs, or sensitive credentials in chat.

I can explain published Elite Packs rules, but I cannot confirm whether your account received a pack, card, Exotic, The Million, credits, a subscription charge, or any personal eligibility/ownership status.
The Whale Pack is Tier 4: 12,500 credits with an Uncommon-or-better floor. It can also drop Exotic (0.050% per card). Drop rates are per card; no specific card is guaranteed.
The Oracle Pack is Tier 5: 15,000 credits with a Rare-or-better floor and the best published Exotic odds (0.080% per card). It has no upgrade offer after opening because it is the top tier.

Payout Boost 100% is a Legendary card: you keep the full profit split on your next payout, usable once per payout cycle, on funded accounts. It is different from Lifetime Split (Exotic) and from Split 70/80/90 cards.
I need the official card name or rarity label from your Inventory/Collection (for example Epic or Legendary). I will not guess from color alone.
